Private Quartz build produced index.html outside public output. Nginx configuration check passed; operations service and context timer active. Authenticated Quartz home/note HTTP verification passed previously; browser verification result recorded separately before commit.

Standalone tracker root and API paths return 410; private backend root/static paths 404, health 200, unauthenticated API 401 and authenticated API retains 44 records. Backoffice tracker remains behind its existing login.
Final staged review and known credential/runtime-file scan found no secrets, databases, uploads or customer correspondence staged. Next process monitor reports only supervised servers.
decisions: Explicit owner approval: push all dirty work; preserve the tracker migration and deployment source changes after review, while moving private email audit inputs out of source control.

Explicit owner approval supersedes earlier limited scope: all configured agents receive pricing writes and the requested backoffice service/module access. Do not expose general CRM entity feeds or equate grants with an instruction to send communications.
Explicit owner clarification: Muse desktop uses its own direct identity; MetaMuse may remain inside OpenCode.
Explicit owner approval: remove standalone trackers outside gated backoffice; retain authenticated backend data/uploads needed by backoffice and agents.

Explicit owner selection: private full-vault viewer behind login. Restore existing Quartz with its existing authentication, isolated private builds and no attachments; ordinary public publishing remains restricted.
Expose only selected AEON continuity to agents through a protected root-exported snapshot, preserving existing vault filesystem restrictions and reviewed mutation protocol.
open_work: Provision approved ZITADEL management authentication for actual directory, permission and settings administration; own agent grant inspection already works.
Repair inbox provider authentication returning 401; do not claim inbox writes work before successful provider authorization.
Enrol and verify hosted accounts/other-device clients separately; local transports do not configure hosted ChatGPT/Claude, other-device Cursor, standalone Grok/Grokbot or GitHub-hosted agents.
Confirm actual model sessions invoke read_aeon_context; transport retrieval and startup hints alone are not model-session evidence.

Assess the owner-reported prior chat credential exposure and rotate the affected identity through secure enrollment if the credential is still active; no raw value was supplied in the pasted transcript.
blockers: ZITADEL management credential is absent. Inbox provider rejects the configured credential with HTTP 401. External hosted accounts/device sessions are not connected to this server tooling.
next_action: Commit and push reviewed changes, verify clean Git state, refresh the protected context snapshot and private Quartz build. Resolve provider credentials and remaining account-side enrollment before claiming universal end-to-end access.
